short.text: Austin Pasztor was a reserve guard for Jacksonville in 2013: an injury-record problem kept him out of the first half of the season, and he then dressed as the primary interior backup for the last {{2013.regular.games:words}} regular-season games and both playoff games. In the 2013 camp he competed with Will Rackley at guard, and he recovered after losing initial leverage and picked up the rush. The staff saw a physical backup who could cover a job, with uneven combination blocks and leverage and less consistent coordination than the starting pair.
